item.text: The repository is a bare fixture—there isn’t an existing post model or list to connect to. I’m adding a small server-only post store plus a tagged cached reader so the action is executable end to end; the key mutation behavior will be `await insertPost(...)` followed by `updateTag('posts')`, which immediately expires the tag rather than using stale-while-revalidate.

item.text:
Implemented a working post creation flow:

- Added the [`createPost` Server Action](/workspace/app/actions.ts:17), which awaits the mutation and then calls `updateTag('posts')`.
- `updateTag` immediately expires tagged entries, so the next read blocks for fresh data instead of serving stale-while-revalidate content. See the [Next.js `updateTag` documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/updateTag).
- Added the [tagged posts list and creation form](/workspace/app/page.tsx:6).
- Added a [server-only in-memory post store](/workspace/lib/posts.ts:30), since the scaffold had no database layer.

Verified with:

- `npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false`
- `npm run build`
- Production smoke test: submitted a post and confirmed the immediately following page load contained it.

The pre-existing `package.json` and `package-lock.json` changes were left untouched.
